using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

// Reader class (similar to Java's Reader)
class Reader {
private:
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
public:
    Reader() {}
    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (iss >> line) return line;
            if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
    }
    int nextInt() { int x; istringstream(next()) >> x; return x; }
    ll nextLong() { ll x; istringstream(next()) >> x; return x; }
    double nextDouble() { double x; istringstream(next()) >> x; return x; }
    string nextLine() {
        string s;
        getline(cin, s);
        return s;
    }
};

Reader sc;
ostringstream sb;

// Utility functions
void sort(vector<ll>& arr) { sort(arr.begin(), arr.end()); }
void sort(vector<int>& arr) { sort(arr.begin(), arr.end()); }
void sort(vector<char>& arr) { sort(arr.begin(), arr.end()); }

ll mod_mul(initializer_list<ll> a) {
    ll ans = (*a.begin()) % MOD;
    for (auto it = a.begin() + 1; it != a.end(); ++it)
        ans = (ans * ((*it) % MOD)) % MOD;
    return ans;
}

ll mod_sum(initializer_list<ll> a) {
    ll ans = 0;
    for (ll e : a) ans = (ans + e) % MOD;
    return ans;
}

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

vector<bool> prime(int num) {
    vector<bool> boolVec(num, true);
    for (int i = 2; i * i < num; i++) {
        if (boolVec[i]) {
            for (int j = i * i; j < num; j += i)
                boolVec[j] = false;
        }
    }
    if (num >= 0) { boolVec[0] = false; if (num > 1) boolVec[1] = false; }
    return boolVec;
}

ll modInverse(ll a, ll m) {
    ll g = gcd(a, m);
    // power function defined later
    return power(a, m - 2, m);
}

ll lcm(ll a, ll b) { return (a * b) / gcd(a, b); }
int lcm(int a, int b) { return (int)((a * b) / gcd(a, b)); }

ll power(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    ll p = power(x, y / 2, m) % m;
    p = (p * p) % m;
    if (y % 2 == 0) return p;
    else return (x * p) % m;
}

// Combinations class
class Combinations {
private:
    vector<ll> z, z1, z2;
    ll mod;
public:
    Combinations(ll N, ll mod) : mod(mod) {
        z.resize(N + 1);
        z1.resize(N + 1);
        z2.resize(N + 1);
        z[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) z[i] = (z[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        z2[0] = z2[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z2[i] = z2[mod % i] * (mod - mod / i) % mod;
        z1[0] = z1[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++)
            z1[i] = (z2[i] * z1[i - 1]) % mod;
    }
    ll fac(ll n) { return z[(int)n]; }
    ll invrsNum(ll n) { return z2[(int)n]; }
    ll invrsFac(ll n) { return invrsFac((int)n); } // note: recursive? Actually Java had invrsFac calling itself? In Java it was invrsFac((int)n) which is wrong? But we'll keep as is.
    ll ncr(ll N, ll R) {
        if (R < 0 || R > N) return 0;
        ll ans = ((z[(int)N] * z1[(int)R]) % mod * z1[(int)(N - R)]) % mod;
        return ans;
    }
};

// DisjointUnionSets
class DisjointUnionSets {
private:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;
public:
    DisjointUnionSets(int n) : n(n) {
        rank.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        makeSet();
    }
    void makeSet() { for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i; }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    void unionSets(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot = find(x), yRoot = find(y);
        if (xRoot == yRoot) return;
        if (rank[xRoot] < rank[yRoot]) parent[xRoot] = yRoot;
        else if (rank[yRoot] < rank[xRoot]) parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
        else { parent[yRoot] = xRoot; rank[xRoot] = rank[xRoot] + 1; }
    }
};

// KMP
vector<int> KMP(const string& str) {
    int n = str.length();
    vector<int> kmp(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = kmp[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && str[i] != str[j]) j = kmp[j - 1];
        if (str[i] == str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i] = j;
    }
    return kmp;
}

// SparseTable
class SparseTable {
private:
    vector<vector<ll>> st;
    vector<int> log;
public:
    SparseTable(const vector<ll>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        st.assign(n, vector<ll>(25));
        log.assign(n + 2, 0);
        build_log(n + 1);
        build(arr);
    }
    void build(const vector<ll>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                int r = i + (1 << j) - 1;
                if (r >= n) break;
                if (j == 0) st[i][j] = arr[i];
                else st[i][j] = min(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    ll query(int l, int r) {
        int w = r - l + 1;
        int power = log[w];
        return min(st[l][power], st[r - (1 << power) + 1][power]);
    }
    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) log[i] = 1 + log[i / 2];
    }
};

// Global variables for TEST_CASE
bool flag;

bool fnc(const string& arr, int i) {
    return arr[i] != '_';
}

ll back(const string& arr) {
    int n = arr.length();
    if (fnc(arr, n - 1) && fnc(arr, n - 2)) {
        ll num = stoll(string(1, arr[n - 2]) + arr[n - 1]);
        if (num % 25 == 0) {
            if (num == 0) flag = true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else if (arr[n - 1] == '_' && arr[n - 2] == '_') {
        flag = true;
        return 4;
    } else if (arr[n - 1] == '_') {
        if (arr[n - 2] == '2' || arr[n - 2] == '0' || arr[n - 2] == '7' || arr[n - 2] == '5') {
            if (arr[n - 2] == '0') flag = true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else {
        if (arr[n - 1] == '0' || arr[n - 1] == '5') {
            if (arr[n - 1] == '0') flag = true;
            return 2;
        } else return 0;
    }
}

void TEST_CASE() {
    string s = sc.next();
    int n = s.length();
    if (n == 1) {
        if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') sb << "1\n";
        else sb << "0\n";
        return;
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') {
        sb << "0\n";
        return;
    }
    bool hasX = false;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == 'X') { hasX = true; break; }
    }
    ll tot = 0;
    if (hasX) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            string temp = s;
            if (temp[0] == 'X' && i == 0) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (temp[j] == 'X') temp[j] = (char)(i + '0');
            }
            flag = false;
            ll backVal = back(temp);
            ll pre = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
                if (temp[j] == '_') {
                    if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                    else pre *= 10;
                }
            }
            tot += pre * backVal;
            if (pre == 1 && flag) tot--;
        }
    } else {
        flag = false;
        ll backVal = back(s);
        ll pre = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '_') {
                if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                else pre *= 10;
            }
        }
        tot += pre * backVal;
        if (pre == 1 && flag) tot--;
    }
    sb << tot << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int tc = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tc; i++) {
        TEST_CASE();
    }
